stem: Why is Kwan seeing Mrs. Gibbs at the grocery store important to this story?

options.label: A
options.text: Mrs. Gibbs gets to meet Halmoni.

options.label: B
options.text: Halmoni is able to explain what wrapping cloths are.

options.label: C
options.text: It leads to Kwan sharing his talent with his classmates.

options.label: D
options.text: It allows Kwan’s classmates to learn how to carry their lunches in a cloth.
